name: Koganei-sou to Konjiki no Agehachou: Sprite Limited Edition
summary:
Includes the content of the First Press Limited Special Edition
+ a specially illustrated box package, two B2 double suede tapestry, a desk mat, a T-shirt with the game logo, a square art print of Kurosaki Ageha, Nagase Kaede and Aizawa Haru, an A4 clear file, and two acrylic keyholders of sprite's mascots.
